motions.purpose: Term-by-term derivation walkthrough: the focused terms of a typeset equation get an accent underline sweep and full opacity while the rest ghost to 28%, and the caption states each step's claim.
motions.model: The equation stays fully rendered at all times (no reflow); focus is pure opacity/filter plus a scaleX underline on data-term spans.
motions.limitations: Terms are authored spans, not parsed math; the walkthrough adds narration order, not mathematical validation.
motions.reducedMotion: Transitions removed; steps still switch instantly under keyboard control.
motions.exportState: The declared exportStep (default: last step, typically the all-terms view) with its caption.
motions.accessibility: Arrow keys navigate steps (data-owns-arrows); the caption is aria-live; dots are labelled buttons; the full equation remains readable in every step.
